label: GitHub-style contribution heatmap
description: A GitHub-style contribution grid: 7 rows (days of the week) by N columns (weeks). Each cell is a small rounded square tinted by an intensity level 0-4 (0 = empty panel, 1-4 = increasing accent tint). Cells pop in on a diagonal left-to-right sweep. Optional eyebrow + title above, an optional contextual caption and a highlighted badge below, plus a less->more legend. The grid IS the scene; cell size adapts to the column count so it stays inside the 9:16 safe band.
validation: data parses into 7 rows of digits 0-4 separated by '/'
every row has the same column count, within [12,26]
cells are generated deterministically by the builder from p.data
